title: Issue-authoring durable journal (infrastructure — not an IDD work item)
body:
This issue is **infrastructure, not an IDD work item**. It is the
repository-level authoring journal designated by repository policy for
the `issue-authoring` skill's owner-marker/publication-token protocol
(`docs/issue-authoring-skill.md`'s "Authoring label lifecycle" section):
the durable record location for a **standalone** authoring set's
pre-create `state=pending` publication-intent record, when no existing
anchor issue is available to host it.

No previous designation existed for this repository (checked
`.github/idd/config.json` and `docs/customization.md`; the only prior
worked example, `kurone-kito/idd-skill#2606`/`#2621`, reused an
already-existing discussion issue as its own anchor+journal rather than
bootstrapping a dedicated one).

- Do not claim or work this issue through the IDD Discover/Claim loop.
- This issue is intentionally closed immediately after creation so
  Discover never surfaces it as an open candidate. Future
  issue-authoring sessions append `<!-- idd-skill-authoring-publication-intent:
  ... -->` comments here via a direct API POST (closed issues still
  accept comments) exactly as the protocol requires -- do not edit or
  delete those comments.
- Bootstrapped 2026-09-08 during authoring of the standalone orphan
  fix for `idd-review-fix.instructions.md` E11's missing read-only
  conflict check, with the repository owner's explicit approval to
  bootstrap a dedicated journal rather than skip the step.
